name: file-guard
description: Keeps Claude's file edits inside the project: refuses writes outside it (symlinks resolved), never lets a tool touch .git internals, and asks before it changes lockfiles, CI workflows, migrations or secrets.

protect.title: Protected files
protect.description: Comma-separated globs inside the project that ask before Claude changes them. ** crosses folders; a pattern without / matches the file name anywhere; !glob exempts.

extraRoots.title: Extra writable folders
extraRoots.description: Comma-separated folders outside the project that Claude may write to (~ allowed), e.g. ~/notes, ~/work/shared-config.

allowClaudeDirs.title: Allow Claude's own folders
allowClaudeDirs.description: Let Claude write its memory, plans, todos and session mods under ~/.claude (never ~/.claude/settings.json).

fenceReads.title: Fence reads too
fenceReads.description: Also refuse Read calls outside the project and the folders above.
